watch_list.summary: Lauren’s write-up on automating with Grok Bot: start with the real goal (not the process), voice-dump how you do the work, teach implicit decisions, let the bot gather its own feedback, then put it on a routine so you’re not the bottleneck.
A new Dr Eggbot v2 bot template adds skills for automating work and life; reinstall it (it’s different from the old one) and ask the old Eggbot to transfer anything you want to keep.
Lauren amplified that Grok Bot can now book flights, hotels, and rental cars and look for the best deal.

items.title: I Didn't Leave My Room for Any of These Shots
items.summary: A 37-second Genjutsu short: record one simple shot at home, then reimagine the location, outfit, and movement without leaving the room.

items.title: How I Pick the Best AI Take Before Going 4K
items.summary: A 44-second workflow short: Claude drafts the shot in 480p through Higgsfield MCP, and only the take you pick gets finalized in Seedance 2.5 4K with the same camera, timing, and sound.

items.title: Zima Blue Director Robert Valley: “Ignoring AI Won’t Make It Go Away”
items.summary: A two-hour conversation with the Zima Blue and Love, Death & Robots director on why craft still matters, when he’d let AI into an animation workflow, and why he’d rather keep his crew than just make films faster.

items.title: 會50種語言，究竟是怎麼學的？！！｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: A one-minute course short with Terry 謝智翔 and 火種計畫 on building a reusable multilingual learning system instead of grinding vocabulary and grammar.

items.title: 用 AI 寫程式你得懂的 CI/CD？新手一支影片看懂
items.summary: A 14-minute beginner walkthrough of CI/CD on Gary’s budgeting app, covering branch, PR, lint/typecheck/test/build, merge, and deploy, plus GitHub Actions and later gates like Playwright and LLM-as-judge.
